headline: Local-first memory daemon for AI agents uses SQLite + ONNX, zero API calls
summary: This new daemon keeps sensitive AI agent context on your machine, eliminating cloud reliance and external API calls. It achieves 95.6% recall@5 on LongMemEval_S without any LLM calls at retrieval.
details: Cloud memory tiers often force sensitive AI agent context to leave your machine, posing privacy and security risks. This new local-first memory daemon addresses this fundamental problem by ensuring all agent data remains on your local system.

The daemon leverages SQLite for storage and ONNX for embeddings, operating with zero API calls. It serves data directly to local clients like Claude Code or Cursor, maintaining complete data sovereignty.

Performance tests show impressive results, with the daemon achieving 95.6% recall@5 on LongMemEval_S on an M1 Mac with 8GB RAM. This performance is competitive with hosted solutions, demonstrating efficiency without cloud dependency.

While local-first is the default, the system is designed for flexibility. It can seamlessly upgrade to cloud storage (pgvector) with a single command, supporting needs like burst inference, team-shared memories, and cross-device synchronization when required.
caption:

headline: Four Years Ago, a Crypto Boss Went Missing. Now His Successor Has
summary: A crypto firm faces renewed uncertainty as its current leader has disappeared, following the unexplained vanishing of its predecessor four years prior. The incidents raise significant questions about the company's future.
details: The current head of an unnamed cryptocurrency company has reportedly gone missing, creating a disturbing parallel to an event four years ago when the firm's previous boss also disappeared without explanation. This latest incident has sent shockwaves through the company and its community.

The initial disappearance of the former crypto executive occurred approximately four years ago, leaving many questions unanswered about the company's leadership and stability. The new vanishing act compounds these concerns, suggesting a deeper, unresolved issue.

Authorities are likely investigating the circumstances surrounding both disappearances, though specific details remain scarce. The lack of information surrounding these high-profile vanishings could impact investor confidence and the overall perception of the crypto entity involved.
